propositions: Repository-wide audit of documentation and source comments against operator standards baseline from 2026-08-20 must establish evidence-based remediation proposals before file changes are authorized.

Writing standards prohibit em dashes, en dashes, spaced hyphens, semicolons, and conjunctive colons; require formal voice with complete sentences and no contractions; forbid filler adjectives and authenticity-padding phrases; and mandate one logical line per Markdown paragraph.

Three exploration shards own discrete documentation surfaces: Shard A owns ADRs and internal durable records; Shard B owns external documentation and shipped help; Shard C owns developer comments and embedded prose, with client-facing strings taking precedence to Shard B.

Forty-nine foundation and remediation items (F01-F49) span documentation ownership policy, prose validation, comment policy, generated-artifact ownership, CLI coverage, templates, configuration guidance, identity setup, ADR lifecycle, infrastructure runbooks, and operator documentation.

Operator approved F01, F06, F07 (documentation policy, navigation, index validation); rejected F02, F03, F04 (mechanical prose validation); revised F05 (generator-local descriptor protocol); and deferred F08-F49 to epic REB-3501 with implementation in progress.

Audit closed after operator ruling on 2026-08-22 with ticket events preserved append-only, no project files changed at handoff, and writing guidance retained as authoring standards without deterministic mechanical enforcement.
